variants.headline: Home world punishes the colony
variants.sub: A punishment has been imposed on {colony} by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has punished the colony. The action establishes a punitive development in the relationship, not the particular effects of that action. Scrutiny of {target} should address the use of authority without adding an unreported restriction, financial loss or change in supplies to the account.

The gazette records the punishment without assigning a particular form to it. A punitive action should be described with due care, since assumptions about its terms could misstate the colony's position. The public interest is served by keeping the known action separate from an inferred account of its operation.

The position of {target} should be assessed without supplying an unreported offence or penalty. This paper records the punitive action while reserving judgment on particulars not established in the report. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.

variants.sub: The colony is the subject of punitive action by the home world.
variants.body:

variants.sub: The home world has punished the colony.
variants.body:
